barn.definition: The big building on a farm where animals sleep and where the hay is kept.
barn.example: The ponies sleep in the barn on cold nights.

dislike.definition: To not like something. Nobody is wrong for disliking a food.
dislike.example: I dislike the smell of fish.

melatonin.definition: The chemical your body makes in the evening when the light fades, to tell you it is time for bed.
melatonin.example: Melatonin rises when the sun goes down.

war_escalation.definition: Taking a matter to a more senior person because it has not moved. Use it only when it is genuinely warranted.
war_escalation.example: If we do not hear back by Friday, we will need to escalate this.
